description: This Java class defines a custom JSP tag StoreLogoUrlTag used to generate the URL for a store's logo image, dynamically constructing the URL based on store configuration, domain, and logo presence.

classes.name: StoreLogoUrlTag
classes.description: Custom JSP tag class to generate the URL of a store's logo image based on store and session configurations.

methods.name: doStartTag
methods.description: Builds and outputs the store logo URL based on store details and configuration.

methods.name: doEndTag
methods.description: Ends the custom JSP tag processing.
